svg.title: Wildframe Puddlewink — original eight-direction three-pose aquatic creature atlas
svg.desc: 24 individually composed wetland creature views. Pearlescent amphibian with scalloped fins, teal translucent back, orange gill tufts, amber eyes, droplet crest, articulated swimming feet and living water highlights. Rows down, down-left, left, up-left, up, up-right, right, down-right.
